variants.briefing:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [Location] to [Destination]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to [MissionMaxSCUSize] in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
variants.prerequisiteSummary: Rookie / 50 rep to Master / 237,750 rep; CrimeStat limited to 2 or below; Stanton 2

pickupLocation.reason: Resolved from ContractPrerequisite_Locality.localityAvailable; exact child pickup locations are generated by the locality pool.
